record.body:
## Rationale
Time-window joins left 70% of attached records ambiguous, and idle-gap windows cut that only to about 36%. A session id cannot be stamped today because the shell exposes none. Per-effort aggregates need only that a session had a record of the effort inside its window, and efforts are the unit the workflow improves.

## Counter-argument
Per-session record counts stay approximate, and a session that touched two efforts counts toward both, so cost sums can double-count. A hook-based session id would give exact per-session attribution going forward. Revisit it if per-effort numbers prove too noisy to act on.

payload.alternatives: add session id to records, idle-gap windows, write-evidence tie-break
payload.choice: Report per-effort aggregates; attribute a session to an effort when a record of that effort falls inside the session window
